title: Smiling Face with Horns Emoji 😈 Meaning: The Flirty Devil
description: The smiling face with horns emoji 😈 is a purple devil grin for mischief, naughty intentions or playful flirting. See what it means and how it differs from 👿.
summary: The 😈 smiling face with horns is a purple devil with a wicked grin. It means mischief: the sender is up to something, feeling naughty, or enjoying being bad. In flirting it signals sexual intent or teasing. It is playful far more often than it is evil.
meaning: Mischief is the core idea. 😈 goes with pranks, schemes, breaking a diet, skipping class, and any plan that starts with “don't tell anyone.” The grin shows the sender is pleased with themselves. It is the emoji of the little devil on the shoulder in old cartoons, the one arguing for the more entertaining choice.

Its best-known use is suggestive. Added to a message between people who are attracted to each other, 😈 turns an innocent sentence into an invitation. “Come over 😈” and “I have plans for you 😈” leave little doubt. It often pairs with 😏, 🔥 or 💦, and it is one of the clearer signals of sexual interest among face emojis.

Beyond flirting, it marks confidence and a competitive edge. Athletes and gamers post it before a matchup to say they intend to dominate, and people use it for “villain era” posts about putting themselves first. Around Halloween it is used literally for devil costumes. Religious meaning is rare; the figure is a cartoon imp, not a statement about the devil.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Among friends it announces mischief: a surprise being planned, a petty act of revenge, a decision to order dessert first. It tells the reader to expect trouble of the fun kind. It can also follow a teasing remark to show the sender enjoyed delivering it.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: This is a strong flirting signal. Someone who sends 😈 after a compliment, a late-night text or a comment on your photo is being suggestive, or testing whether you will be. A reply in kind escalates things. If you are not interested, answering plainly works better than ignoring it.

contexts.label: In sports and gaming
contexts.body: It is a statement of intent: “finals tomorrow 😈.” Players use it after an aggressive play or a win they are smug about. Team accounts post it when a star returns from injury. The message is menace as entertainment, not real hostility.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: Its sexual associations make it a poor fit for professional settings. Even an innocent “I have an idea 😈” can be misread. Use 😏 sparingly or simply describe the plan. The one dependable exception is seasonal: a devil emoji on the invitation to the office Halloween party will not raise eyebrows.

examples.text: I hid all his left shoes 😈
Rematch this weekend. You're not ready 😈
Diet starts Monday. Tonight we order everything 😈
Guess who has the group chat screenshots 😈
examples.meaning: Holding something over friends and enjoying it.
Literal use for a Halloween outfit.

combos.meaning: Feeling bold and dangerous, or describing something as wickedly hot.
A smirk followed by intent; unmistakable flirtation.
Angel and devil: innocent on the outside, mischievous underneath.

confusedWith.difference: 👿 is the same purple devil with a frown and furrowed brows. It suggests resentment, spite or anger. 😈 smiles and is about fun, temptation and flirting.
😏 is a sly half-smile that hints at innuendo or smugness. 😈 goes further, openly declaring naughty or scheming intent, and is less subtle.
👹 is a red Japanese oni mask with horns and fangs, tied to folklore and used for monsters or fierce looks. 😈 is a Western-style cartoon devil used for mischief.

avoid: Do not send it to coworkers, clients or anyone who could reasonably read it as a sexual advance.
Avoid it with someone you have just met unless you intend to flirt.
Be cautious in religious contexts, where devil imagery may be taken seriously.
design: A face with two horns, arched eyebrows and a broad, toothy or closed grin. Apple, Google, Samsung and most others color it purple, which has become its recognizable look. It is the smiling counterpart of the angry face with horns, which keeps the same head and swaps the grin for a scowl.

faqs.q: What does 😈 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: Most often he is flirting and hinting at something sexual, especially in a late-night or one-on-one chat. Among male friends it means mischief, bragging or competitiveness. The setting tells you which.

faqs.q: What does 😈 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: She is being playful and bold: teasing you, hinting at attraction or admitting to doing something naughty. With friends it usually means she is plotting something or feeling confident.

It frequently is. It is widely understood as a sign of sexual or flirtatious intent between adults. It also has innocent uses for pranks, indulgence and competition, so it is not sexual in every message.

faqs.q: Why is the devil emoji purple?
faqs.a: It is a design convention, not a rule in the Unicode standard, which only describes a smiling face with horns. The major vendors all draw it in purple, which also keeps it visually distinct from the red angry faces.

faqs.q: How can I tell 😈 and 👿 apart?
faqs.a: Mood. 😈 is happy to be bad: cheeky, tempting, confident. 👿 is unhappy and stewing: bitter, vengeful or grumpy. People send the smiling one far more often.
